This '''Advanced Recon Commando''' [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] was present at the [[First Battle of Kamino]].

==History==
This [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]], alongside another [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando (Kamino)|ARC]] and [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] were brought out of [[stasis pod]]s to be used to defend their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] and his brothers saved a group of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] from [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The group destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and told the cadets to grab their [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. After the battle, Alpha began to lecture the cadets. While in the middle of his lecture, [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] rolled in and shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the two ARCs.<ref name="R50" />
